msg: The colors come in pairs. Green goes with Brown and Purple goes with Red. Lets say you pick the Green Gnome and it gives you 9 points. You'll want to stick with Green and Brown until you get 4 points or less, then switch to the other color pairs. Streaks can last a while, or can be quite quick, so try to keep track of the amount of points you get with your choices. Always remember to make your choices as fast as possible since you only have 1.5 seconds to make a decision. If you take too long you'll get a "Too Slow" message and not get any points.
